_doc: Table 2 (ablation study) of Chen et al. (2025), Text-to-SQL for Enterprise Data Analytics, arXiv:2507.14372v1, p. 6. Values copied from the rendered page (visual check of the PDF page, not only text extraction), 2026-11-07. Percentages as published (integers). score_4plus = share of benchmark questions whose generated query an LLM judge rated 4 or 5 on a 1-5 scale against ground truth (correct or almost correct). compile = successful compilation. valid_schema = queries with valid tables and columns (no schema hallucination). The table is a single run of an internal benchmark (>130 questions); no confidence intervals are published.

validator_scope.detects: Trino EXPLAIN in VALIDATE mode (syntax, function usage, table name, column name) plus a hallucination validator that checks extracted tables and columns against the table and column index
validator_scope.explicitly_not_covered: invalid column values (left to future work)
validator_scope.verbatim: For hallucination, we focus on invalid tables and columns, which are easy to detect and affect the query structurally, and leave invalid column values to future work.
